checks.name: feature flag registry
checks.message: Feature flag registry should include rollout flags with owners and explicit rollout env names.

checks.name: kill switches
checks.message: Kill-switch registry should include operational emergency controls.

checks.name: experiment registry
checks.message: Experiment registry should include at least one experiment with variants totaling 100 and explicit override env names.

checks.name: environment template
checks.message: .env.example should document rollout, experiment, and kill-switch variables.

checks.name: workflow execution kill switch wired
checks.message: Workflow dispatch should be protected by the workflow execution kill switch.

checks.name: webhook processing kill switch wired
checks.message: Webhook routes should return controlled responses when webhook processing is disabled.

checks.name: MCP mutation kill switch wired
checks.message: MCP route should block mutating tools when the MCP mutation kill switch is enabled.

checks.name: feature flag runbook
checks.message: Feature flag runbook should cover kill switches, rollout, and audit rules.

checks.name: A/B testing runbook
checks.message: A/B testing runbook should cover variants, primary metrics, and guardrails.

checks.name: feature flag audit log
checks.message: Feature flag changes should have an audit log template.
